title: Pip and the Wobbly Golden Pumpkin
moral: Telling the truth, even when it's hard, makes our hearts feel light.
description: It's Pumpkin Face Party day in Clover Wood! Pip, Tumble and Hazel paint pumpkins with happy, sad and surprised faces, but Nana Hoot's special Golden Pumpkin is just for looking... Learn the names of feelings like happy, sad, surprised, worried and proud in this funny animated story about honesty, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Guess what, friends? Nana Hoot's pumpkin patch was full of big, round, orange pumpkins!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo! Tonight is the Pumpkin Face Party! Paint a face that shows a feeling, like happy, sad or surprised!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: But please don't touch my Golden Pumpkin. It's special. It's just for looking!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Super-duper! I'll paint the best feeling face EVER!
Pip zoomed off, tripped on a curly vine and... BONK! A pumpkin lid landed on his head like a silly orange hat!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Oopsie-trunk! Pip, you look like a pumpkin!

narration.text: In the garden, Pip painted two eyes and a great big smile. Swish, swish!
Look at Pip's pumpkin, friends. What feeling does a big smile show?
HAPPY! Yes! A big smile means happy!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: My pumpkin feels SAD. See? A frown, and one blue tear. Drip!
Then Tumble's trunk got tickly... AH... AH... AH-CHOO! Blue paint flew everywhere, and Pip got a bright blue nose!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Hee-hee! Now I'm a blue-nosed fox!

popups.sub: round eyes and an O mouth

narration.text: By the hay bales, Hazel the hedgehog painted two round eyes, two tall eyebrows and a mouth like a big round O.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I know! I know! That's a... HUNGRY face! It wants a sandwich!
Tee-hee! Silly Pip! Round eyes and an O mouth. What feeling is that, friends?

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: SURPRISED! Like this... BOING!
All her prickles stood straight up! Surprised is when something happens that you did not expect.

narration.text: Pip took a big, deep breath. In... and out.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Nana, it was me. I touched your Golden Pumpkin. It rolled down the hill, and the stalk broke. I'm sorry.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Thank you for telling me the truth, Pip. That was brave. I am PROUD of you!
Pip's worried feeling floated away like a bubble. POP! Now he felt light and happy.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! And you know what? That carrot makes a super-duper NOSE!
So they painted a big proud smile, and the carrot became the funniest nose in Clover Wood!

narration.text: That night, the pumpkins glowed like lanterns. Happy, sad, surprised, worried and proud!
Let's remember! What feeling has a big smile?

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HAPPY! HONK-HONK!
And what feeling did Pip have when his tummy went wiggly?

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Worried! But telling the truth made it float away!

narration.text: Everyone danced the Wiggly Pumpkin Wobble until the moon was high.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Rumble, rumble... oopsie-trunk! That's my tummy. Is it pumpkin pie time?
Telling the truth made Pip's heart feel light. Goodnight, Golden Pumpkin!
